title: Recording Sheet Cancel & Cleanup
requirements: Add a visible Cancel/Close Button to RecordingView in all states (recording, not-recording, finalizing): labeled "Cancel" during recording and triggering onCancel; disabled during finalizing until pipeline completion, then re-enabled as Close
Wire the existing onCancel callback to the Cancel button action (currently never triggered by any element)
Add .onDisappear { onCancel() } fallback on RecordingView so dismissal via window close / Escape triggers onCancel when completedEntry is nil
ListViewModel.isRecording is reset to false on cancel / dismiss-without-completion — no path leaves it stuck true
If completedEntry is nil on dismiss and a partial .m4a file exists at tempURL, delete it via FileManager.removeItem (catch and log only — no orphaned audio files in ~/Documents)
Retain .interactiveDismissDisabled(isRecording || isFinalizing) for swipe-to-dismiss; after a failed start the sheet is closable via the Cancel button
acceptance_criteria: Closing the recording sheet at any state returns the app to a clean cancellable state; ListViewModel.isRecording is false afterwards
No orphan .m4a files remain in ~/Documents after a cancelled recording that had a partial file
A Cancel button is always visible during the recording state
out_of_scope: Save-vs-discard recovery on cancel (audio is deleted on cancel)
